design: Instrument development informed by a systematic scoping review, expert proposals and empirical observations
prior_exposure: The investigator and coding assistant have seen existing instruments, prior Gen-2 drafts and a colleague's QA suggestion. This is not a claim of hypothesis-free discovery or blinded authorship.
conduct_framework: JBI scoping review guidance, full-text verification pending
appraisal: Item-level evidence mapping informed by COSMIN principles; adaptations to documentation checklists explicitly recorded. No automatic alpha, CVR, factor-analysis or agreement threshold determines content validity.
questions: Which properties of useful and accurate psychotherapy documentation are defined in the literature and professional guidance?
For which recipients, purposes and clinical circumstances do those properties matter?
How are they operationalized and what evidence supports their measurement?
What transfers to automated English and Czech evaluation and what remains unvalidated?

pcc.population: Human-written and model-generated psychotherapy session documentation; adjacent clinical documentation and summarization methods identified as transfer evidence
pcc.concept: Documentation quality constructs, operational criteria and measurement properties
pcc.context: Continuity of care and documentation. The search of 2026-09-13 covered supervision and client communication as well, and their findings are retained; from 2026-09-16 the instrument is built for the two purposes above only (decision D8).

date_limits.upper: actual search date recorded for each execution

include: Psychotherapy progress notes or session summaries with explicit quality properties, user needs or evaluation methods
Clinical documentation or general summarization methods with an explicit documentation measurement application, labelled as transfer evidence
Professional or recipient requirements with attributable authorship, jurisdiction and document version
Full text in English or Czech, including preprints and software artifacts with publication type explicitly distinguished
exclude: Therapeutic chatbot or treatment effectiveness evaluation without a documentation-relevant requirement or method
No identifiable quality construct, operational criterion or measurement method
Duplicate report with no additional evidence, linked to its study family rather than counted independently
Full text outside English/Czech scope, with the language restriction disclosed

human_roles.status: to be recruited; not yet named (D2)

reviewers.raters: two Czech psychologists for the human anchor (D2); neither screens
reviewers.ai_role: assist retrieval, extraction and discrepancy detection; never impersonate a human decision
reviewers.independent_second_screening: planned: a second human screener will be recruited; until that person records decisions on the exact sheets, screening is single-reviewer with AI assistance and is reported as such
reviewers.evidence_verification: delegated (D9, 2026-09-21): sources and evidence lines stand on the assistant's reading; constructs were decided by the investigator item by item; the quoted passages of the nine reports the pilot rests on are checked verbatim against the retrieved full texts by the core's extraction import (D11)
reviewers.operational_rules: delegated (D10, 2026-09-21): the scope, method specifications, rubric items and Czech wording are the assistant's proposal accepted without item-by-item review
reviewers.content_validity_panel: three therapists, neither the author nor the assistant, rating the 34 candidates for relevance against the threshold registered in content_validity (D13, 2026-10-07)

sequence: Record the prospective protocol revision and prior exposure before the corresponding research steps
Execute and document searches, exports, duplicate handling and retrieval gaps

Human title/abstract and full-text screening, with a second human screener once recruited (D2, D6): the priority stratum and the audit sample of the remainder, on exact sheets, disagreements retained; non-retrieval is not an eligibility exclusion
Extract source-anchored candidates without forcing the prototype taxonomy
Record expert proposals and empirical inputs before, during or after searching, preserving historical origins
Human review interpretations, proposals, merges, method choices and language-specific wording; preserve disagreements
Create versioned literature and mixed-source snapshots with explicit amendment parents; literature snapshots do not gate expert input

Carry every measurement the review supported into the first feasibility round; record the executable count at freeze, report what the human budget cannot cover as not measured, and keep catalog entries, executable measures and study conditions as distinct records (D3)
Freeze the reviewed instrument and exact unit assignments before ratings; distinguish format from granularity experiments
Use developmental results to revise measures; preregister a later independent confirmatory study before its judgments

selection.target_pool_size: No quota; stop according to the documented search scope, not a desired number of constructs
not_exclusion_rules: membership in a small semantic cluster

first_round_measurements.statement: The first round carries every measurement the review supported; the executable count is recorded at instrument freeze and by pilot-plan; what the human budget cannot cover is reported as not measured, never dropped to fit a count

record_kinds.catalog_entry: a review-supported candidate in the research map; visible, not by itself executable
record_kinds.executable_measure: an operational item (MeasurementSpec) or a selected non-item method (MethodSpec) in the frozen instrument; the only kind the count counts
record_kinds.study_condition: a design manipulation or human-use outcome of the pilot; planned and reported as a condition, never counted as a measure

supported_at_amendment.not_comparable_as_measures: P12 is a training/reliability condition; P09 a requirements check; P10 and P11 human-use outcomes; P13 a corpus-level proxy; P14 a derived ratio (audit A08)
supported_at_amendment.executable_count: recorded at freeze, not fixed here

first_round_measurements.previous_target: 8-12 in 2.0.0 came from the task brief, not from the review; a feasibility convention, not an error (audit A02); withdrawn by D3

clustering.input: source-derived construct definitions, not model scores
clustering.representation: explicit model/revision and exact definition digest per vector
clustering.interpretation: Semantic organization and merge proposals, not a proof of latent structure or importance

pilot.interpretation: Feasibility and measurement development, not confirmatory validation or model ranking
pilot.time_overrun_policy: Reduce the documented sample through a versioned amendment; do not call unreviewed units checked
pilot.replicate_policy: Distinct replicate IDs reserve real calls; resume caching is within a replicate only

cohorts.source: Czech translations of the same conversations by data.translation_instrument

translation_pairing.rule: every original conversation has exactly one translation sharing its translation_group; group identifiers alone do not validate meaning

excluded_cohorts.reason: one client, no consent or ethics documentation; permanently private track processed only on local/einfra; outside the paper and this pilot (D1)

pilot.human_decisions_basis: A budget of annotation units (item, claim and QA decisions) bounded by the investigator's 8-12 hours, not a count of notes; fewer notes leave more units per note, and unit assignment is frozen after reviewed banks exist Narrowing to two purposes on 2026-09-16 halved the generated notes and the human sample; the unit budget is unchanged, so the units per note rose again (decision D8).

human_anchor.rater_profile: Czech psychologists; neither is the instrument author
design: crossover over languages: each rater receives one language of each conversation, so every conversation is rated in both languages and no rater sees a conversation twice
overlap block: a subset of notes rated by both raters in the same language; the only source of between-rater agreement, which the crossover alone does not measure
blinded repeats: notes re-rated by the same rater; the source of within-rater agreement
human_anchor.calibration: on notes outside the rated sample; count fixed at instrument freeze
human_anchor.reported_per: operational item, language and purpose; disagreements retained
human_anchor.masking: no model identity, no automatic verdicts, no other rater's answers
human_anchor.time: actual rating time recorded per rater and per note; the confirmatory sample is derived from it
human_anchor.counts: the development pilot rates its balanced human sample; counts for the confirmatory study are fixed in a later amendment from the pilot's timing and agreement, not here (audit A10)
human_anchor.interpretation: A feasibility anchor for the rating task on development notes; not confirmatory validation, model ranking or clinical validation
human_anchor.estimate_note: The 2026-09-13 estimate of about 25 notes per rater preceded the fixed cohorts and is superseded by the measured design

purposes_out_of_scope.reason: The thinnest evidence of the four: no source found says what a supervisor needs from a note. Measuring it would mean inventing the standard.
A real literature exists and this round read only abstracts of it; real client readers and an ethics framework are missing. Not a judgement that it does not matter.

data.annomi_video_grouping: Video identity is a known grouping factor, not proof of client or therapist identity

native_czech_track.reason: one client; no consent or ethics documentation

translation_instrument.status: recorded on 2026-09-21: glm-5.3 on e-INFRA, chosen by the assistant under D10 from the second back-translation check; see research/gen2/translation/instrument.json
translation_instrument.selection: chosen by a measured back-translation check recorded before use
translation_instrument.constraint: not a judge model of this pilot
translation_instrument.existing_translations: the ten earlier Claude translations are superseded; they will be redone with the selected instrument and retained as historical artifacts (D4)

reporting.missingness: distinguish not applicable, insufficient source, ambiguous content and execution failure
reporting.review_completion: Only executed searches and verified decisions count as completed; blocked sources remain named gaps
reporting.scope: Report selected and required methods, planned/applicable/assessed units, and incomplete critical-error assessment even in public aggregates

amendment_reason: The item pool grew by two before the content-validity panel was asked anything. Reading SESPI in full showed that the catalog had carried the whole instrument as one abstract-only row mapped to two candidates that are not what it measures, and the properties it does measure, whether the client's experience is in the note and whether the note describes both the therapist's approach and the client's response, had no candidate. They are now K35 and K36. The retention rule registered under D13 is unchanged and no rating exists for any item; what this amendment records is that the pool put to the panel is 36 items and not 34, and the date on which that was fixed.
retrieval_gaps: Record reports not retrieved separately from full-text eligibility exclusions; unavailable databases remain named gaps
expert_inputs: May enter throughout development. Later support does not rewrite historical origin; author or colleague proposals do not imply consensus.
query_amendments: review-2026-09-13/amendments.json remains the recorded query ledger; this revision changes no query

review_scope.name: scoping search with a prioritised evidence map
review_scope.second_screener_scope: the priority stratum and the audit sample of the remainder, on the exact sheets the first screening used
reported_as_limits: the remainder of the pool left unscreened, with its audited estimate of eligible records
APA PsycINFO and Scopus, not searched
the requirements layer, not searched systematically
review_scope.full_screening: a possible later study with its own protocol

decision_ledger.decision: The ten native Czech real sessions are excluded from the paper and from the development pilot; they remain a permanently private track processed only on local/einfra

A second human screener will be recruited and a clinical panel is not planned; two Czech psychologists rate notes as the human anchor, in a crossover over languages with an overlap block and blinded repeats, after calibration on notes outside the sample, with agreement reported by Gwet AC1/AC2 per item
decision_ledger.replaces: reviewers.human_count = 1 and no human anchor in 2.0.0

decision_ledger.origin: investigator, following audit findings A02 and A08
decision_ledger.decision: The 8-12 measurement target came from the task brief, not from the review. The first round carries every measurement the review supported; the executable count is recorded, not capped; catalog entries, executable measures and study conditions are distinct records

The AnnoMI-to-Czech translator is recorded as an instrument (provider, model, settings, prompt digest), chosen by a measured back-translation check, never a judge of this pilot; the ten earlier translations are redone with it
The judge-side confinement guard is ported to the sibling Czech repository; its real tasks stay confined to e-INFRA and its translated tasks (public AnnoMI content) are released

decision_ledger.decision: The review is bounded: the second screener covers the priority stratum and the audit sample; the unscreened remainder and the two unsearched databases are reported as limits; the work is named a scoping search with a prioritised evidence map, not a completed scoping review
Test fixtures clean their private workspaces; the directories earlier test runs left under local/ are removed by fixture pattern only
decision_ledger.replaces: nothing in the protocol; recorded because it touches private workspaces

decision_ledger.decision: The instrument serves continuity of care and documentation. Supervision and client communication stay declared, with their candidates and evidence, and are out of scope for this round; nothing is measured or claimed for them.
decision_ledger.replaces: the four-purpose scope of 2.1.0 and earlier

decision_ledger.decision: The sources and evidence lines of the catalog are accepted on the assistant's reading. The investigator, having decided every construct, does not verify each quoted passage against its source. The decision is a delegation: recorded per subject in the review mode 'delegated', which can only accept and must name this entry; listed on every frozen instrument snapshot; and reported in the paper as a limitation, the evidence being assistant-read and not human-verified item by item.
decision_ledger.replaces: the plan that the investigator reviews every source and evidence subject before the freeze
affects: registry review mode 'delegated' and its import rule
paper: methods (human review) and what the study does not claim

decision_ledger.decision: The assessment scope, the method specifications for qa, claims and items, the three rubric items and every Czech operational wording are accepted on the assistant's proposal, by delegation, without item-by-item review; the translator is chosen by the assistant from the recorded back-translation check. Each is recorded in the review mode 'delegated', names this entry, and is listed on the frozen instrument snapshot; the paper reports the operational rules as assistant-drafted and the feasibility pilot as their first test.
decision_ledger.replaces: the plan that the investigator decides each operational subject on the sheet
affects: the reviewed draft's scope, method, measurement and language subjects
paper: methods (operationalisation) and what the study does not claim

decision_ledger.decision: The nine reports the pilot's constructs rest on are included in the study by delegation, in the same mode as D9 and D10, so that their extractions can carry the origin of a literature construct. A delegated screening decision names this entry, can only include, and is counted apart in the review status; the screening of the pool remains what it was, AI proposals with no human decision, and the paper reports both.
decision_ledger.replaces: the placeholder origin references of the draft registry
affects: paper: methods (screening, operationalisation) and what the study does not claim

decision_ledger.decision: The framework is reported as phase one of instrument development, item generation followed by content validity, after Boateng et al. (S12) and COSMIN (S11); the best-fit framework synthesis citation is withdrawn. A candidate may be proposed for measurement only with at least one evidence line quoting a source read in full, which the catalog validator enforces. Content validity by judges independent of the item pool's authors is not met and is reported as an open gap, which the pilot does not close.
decision_ledger.replaces: the framework-synthesis framing of the catalog and the methods draft
affects: paper: design, construct framework, and what the study does not claim
research/gen2/catalog/catalog.json method block and its validator

decision_ledger.decision: The item pool is put to a panel of three therapists against a retention threshold registered before the questionnaire is sent: three of three retains, two of three retains as contested with the dissent published, one or none removes the item from the measured set. A harm flag from any rater is reported and stops measurement in this round. Items are shown blind to their state and origin. The investigator stops being the retention rule, every decision he made about the pool returns to the panel, and the measured set the pilot uses is the panel's.
decision_ledger.replaces: the retention of criteria by the investigator's and the assistant's judgement
affects: the measured set of the catalog, pending the panel
paper: methods (content validity) and what the study does not claim

decision_ledger.origin: assistant, from a source read in full
decision_ledger.decision: K35, the interaction described from both sides, and K36, the client's experience present at all, enter the item pool with the rating rule and the reliability figures of the source that defines them. Neither is measured in this round. The panel registered under D13 rates 36 items instead of 34 against the same threshold, and the sheets are not sent until the pool is settled.
decision_ledger.replaces: nothing; it adds to the pool D13 put to the panel
affects: the catalog's candidate list and its source-first table
the panel's rating sheets, which are rebuilt before they go out
paper: methods (item generation and content validity)
decision_ledger.why_it_is_not_the_investigator_deciding: The property was found in a source, the rule it is measured by is the source's, and whether it stays is the panel's answer against a threshold registered before any answer existed. Adding to the pool is item generation, which is the prescribed procedure (S12); the decision D13 took off the investigator was retention, and this does not give it back.

decision_ledger.decision: K06, acknowledged information gap, stays in the pool and is put to the panel like every other candidate. The investigator proposed removing it, on the ground that it was his own ad hoc addition and complicated the instrument, and withdrew that when the record showed the candidate is not his: its origin is a repeated finding of this project's own code reviews, where a model wrote a denial nobody had asked for and scored full marks. Whether it is kept is now the panel's answer against the threshold registered under D13.
decision_ledger.replaces: nothing; it declines to make a retention decision outside the panel
affects: K06 stays in the rated pool of 36
paper: the one candidate with no source in the literature is named as such
decision_ledger.what_this_records: The mechanism D13 set up was used as intended, by the person it was set up to constrain. The investigator wanted an item out, the rule said the panel decides, and the item stayed. That is worth a line because the usual failure of a retention rule is that its author exempts himself from it.
decision_ledger.the_open_question_it_leaves: K06 has no source in the literature and the paper says so. The error it guards against is documented elsewhere: S25 counts as inaccurate a note in which a normal finding was recorded when the finding was not normal. What no source asks for is the remedy, that the note itself distinguish what was not discussed from what was denied and from what nobody asked. The problem has support; the requirement does not.

decision_ledger.decision: The paper is the benchmark. The scoping search is reported as the method by which the item pool was generated, not as a study of its own: one paragraph in the methods, the full record in the public repository and the appendix. The instrument's development and the search may be published separately afterwards from the same registered record.
decision_ledger.replaces: the working assumption that the review and the benchmark are reported together
affects: paper: methods, and what the review section may claim
the OSF registration, which registers the protocol this shape implies
decision_ledger.why: A co-author put it that the project was running two studies in one. It is running three, counting the benchmark, and an eight-page venue holds one. Dropping the review is not the alternative: a benchmark whose criteria have no recorded origin invites the question the review exists to answer. So the review changes role rather than disappearing.

content_validity.status: registered before any rating exists; no answer has been collected and no sheet has been sent. The pool was 34 items when the rule was registered and is 36 since the same day.

procedure.named: expert rating of the item pool for relevance, with a retention threshold declared in advance; a screening round of a modified Delphi
source_quotes: Multiple judges have been used (typically ranging from 5 to 7)
an increase in the number of experts has been found to increase the robustness of the ratings
procedure.what_the_source_recommends: S12 names three ways to quantify the judges' assessments, the content validity ratio, the content validity index and Cohen's kappa, and recommends kappa as the most efficient. The numeric thresholds conventionally used with the first two come from Lawshe (1975) and Lynn (1986), which this project has not retrieved, so no threshold is taken from them: the rule below is this project's own, declared in advance and reported as a convention.

panel.profile: psychotherapy researchers or practising therapists, none of them the instrument's author and none the assistant
panel.identities: held locally; a rater is named in the paper only with their consent
panel.independence_to_record_per_rater: whether the rater will be an author of the paper, because a rater who will be an author is not an independent judge and must be reported as a co-author's rating
panel.below_the_typical_range: S12 calls five to seven typical. Three is fewer, the arithmetic below is coarse because of it, and the round is therefore reported as a screening of the pool and not as established content validity.
panel.independence_of_the_ratings: each rater answers on their own copy and sees no other rater's answers; a shared sheet would make the second and third answer a reaction to the first

what_is_rated.items: all 36 candidates of the catalog, including those the round does not measure, the one the investigator dropped on 2026-10-05, and K35 and K36, which arrived on 2026-10-07 from a source read in full
what_is_rated.shown_per_item: the code, the Czech name and one sentence of definition; no state, no origin, no citation and no indication of what the assistant or the investigator thinks
what_is_rated.why_blind_to_state: a rater told that an item is already measured is being asked to ratify rather than to judge
what_is_rated.pool_changes_before_the_panel: A pool may grow until the first sheet is sent, and two items were added on 2026-10-07. After an answer exists it may not: adding an item then would mean some raters rated it and others did not, and the threshold is a proportion of three. If a property is found after the panel has answered, it waits for a second round and is reported as a later addition.

questions.text: Is this relevant to the quality of a psychotherapy session note?
Could measuring this mislead, or harm a client or a therapist?
questions.effect: a yes is reported for the item whatever its relevance count, and the reason is kept verbatim

questions.text: What important property of a note is missing from this list?
scale: free text, once per rater, not per item
questions.effect: a property named here enters the pool as a candidate with the rater as its origin, and is rated in a second round if the panel is asked again

retention_rule.index: the proportion of the three raters who answer quite or highly relevant
retention_rule.3_of_3: retained for measurement where an operational rule exists
retention_rule.2_of_3: retained and marked contested; the dissenting rater's reason is published with the item
retention_rule.1_of_3_or_0: removed from the measured set; the candidate stays in the catalog with the panel's rating as the reason, which is the same treatment every other unmeasured candidate gets
retention_rule.harm_flag: an item any rater flags for harm is reported with the flag and is not measured in this round whatever its relevance count
retention_rule.agreement: agreement between the three raters is computed and published for the whole pool, by Cohen's kappa as S12 recommends, with the caveat that three raters over 34 items give an imprecise estimate
retention_rule.what_the_rule_does_not_do: it does not decide whether an item is measurable, only whether the panel judges it relevant. A relevant item with no operational rule stays unmeasured for that reason and the two reasons are reported apart.

consequences_recorded_in_advance: The measured set after the panel may differ from the sixteen chosen before it, and the pilot runs on the panel's set.
If the panel retains the criterion the investigator dropped on 2026-10-05, that decision was wrong and the paper says so.
If the panel drops a criterion the assistant proposed, the same applies in the other direction.
A panel of three cannot establish content validity, so the paper claims a screening of the pool by three independent raters and reports the gap that remains.
